system.description: Mountebanks are versatile users of magical items, and can use any magical item usable by mortals, even those normally only usable by members of a particular class. This includes the use of spell scrolls, and when using a spell scroll with a cleric or druid spell on it, treat the spell as if it were a wizard spell when determining if it is too high a circle for the mountebank to cast without a chance of failure.
